exposure: Care by caseload midwifery teams with affiliation to a university hospital
outcome: Rate of transfer from home to hospital
cohort: A total of 268 women who initiated a homebirth and were cared for by caseload midwifery teams with affiliation to a university hospital.
finding: The majority of women initiating a homebirth in this model experienced a vaginal birth, with approximately 28% transferred to hospital mainly due to slow labor progress or prolonged rupture of membranes, and only two neonatal admissions requiring minor observation/treatment.
mod_finding: The majority of the women (92%) who initiated a homebirth experienced a vaginal birth regardless of their final birthplace.
